blocks.heading: Rules From the Bodies That Set Them
rows: UPSC Civil Services (CSE 2026)
A recognised bachelor's degree. Age 21 to 32 on 1 August 2026 for the general category. Six attempts for the general category. Relaxations apply by category.
An attempt at the Prelims counts as an attempt at the exam.
SSC CGL
A bachelor's degree in any subject for most posts. Age limits differ by post and are set in the notice.
Some posts add subject conditions, so read the post list.
IBPS PO (bank probationary officer)
Age 20 to 30 in the 2026 cycle, with category relaxations.
Open to every stream, so the pool is not limited to commerce.
CAT (for MBA and PGDM at the IIMs and many other institutes)
A bachelor's degree with at least 50% marks (45% for SC, ST and PwBD). Final-year students can apply. No age limit.
Meeting the rule only lets you sit the exam. Each institute sets its own selection weights.
ICAI, CA direct entry to Intermediate
Commerce graduates with at least 55%, other graduates with at least 60%. Final-year students can register provisionally.
It skips the Foundation level. It does not shorten the later exams or articleship.
UGC-NET and PhD admission
A master's degree with at least 55% (general category) for Assistant Professor eligibility. UGC has also opened JRF and PhD admission to four-year bachelor's holders with 75%.
Check the current NTA bulletin for category cut-offs.

figures.label: Education Budget Amount
figures.source: A worked example, not a rule: if your family can put Rs 10 lakh into your whole education, start with about Rs 1 lakh for one more credential. The other Rs 9 lakh protects your living costs and pays for the skills and projects that build a portfolio. If one course asks for more than about Rs 2 lakh, it needs the proof listed above.
